residual_risks: scripts/check-shared-checkout-guard-wiring.sh:19 uses `set -uo pipefail`, omitting `-e`. Every pre-existing check-*.sh script in scripts/ uses `set -euo pipefail` unanimously (6/6: check-loop-select.sh:22, check-secrets.sh:19, check-dispatch-seats-declared.sh:63, check-byte-slices.sh:32, check-pr-body-consistency.sh:16, check-image-tags-immutable.sh:79) — the new file breaks that category's unanimity. Currently inert (every command in the script runs inside an if/pass()/fail() conditional, where set -e never triggers regardless of the flag), but a future edit adding an unconditioned command to this script would silently continue past its failure instead of aborting like its six siblings do.
testing_gaps: check-shared-checkout-guard-wiring.sh asserts (checks 2-3) that scripts/guard-shared-checkout is present, executable on disk, and tracked 100755 in the git index, but does not apply that same assertion to itself or to the two harness scripts it wires into CI (scripts/test-guard-shared-checkout.sh, scripts/test-check-shared-checkout-guard-wiring.sh) — a mode regression on any of those three would surface only as an opaque CI shell-invocation failure rather than a named wiring-check failure.
